methodology: This adapter reads the public DeepSWE v1.1 live leaderboard published by Datacurve, keeps each frontier model's best run across reasoning efforts on 113 original long-horizon software engineering tasks, ranks them by pass rate, and stores daily StoryOps snapshots so the skyline replays how the coding frontier moves.

historical.source: Internet Archive captures of the DeepSWE leaderboard artifacts
notes: Each historical frame is a real DeepSWE leaderboard artifact captured by the Internet Archive; frame dates use the artifact's own generated_at when present, otherwise the capture date.

The earliest frame comes from the pre-versioned artifacts/leaderboard.json (the May 13 DeepSWE Pier job); later frames come from v1 leaderboard-live.json captures. Scores stay comparable because both run the same original task set, but the roster of scored models grows across frames.
Historical-only models keep their archived identity; model names are mapped onto current entity IDs where the model is still scored.
